title: Fee Schedule — The Base Charge for a Lateness on Belrose Promotional Financing Plans
content:
# Fee Schedule — The Base Charge for a Lateness on Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

The base charge for a lateness on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan turns on whether any lateness charge counts against the plan inside the stretch, and on how long the plan has been billing.

| The plan inside the stretch | The base charge |
|---|---|
| At least one lateness charge counts against it | The term's repeat fee |
| No lateness charge counts against it, **and** the plan has been billing for fewer whole calendar months than this desk's opening band of **6** whole calendar months | The term's first-lateness fee reduced by this desk's opening-band share, that share being **50 percent** of the fee, the figure rounded to the cent |
| Any other case | The term's first-lateness fee |

## Figures by term

| Term | First-lateness fee | Repeat fee | First-lateness fee reduced by the opening-band share |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 29.00 USD | 39.00 USD | 14.50 USD |
| 12-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 29.00 USD | 39.00 USD | 14.50 USD |
| 18-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 32.00 USD | 41.00 USD | 16.00 USD |
| 24-Month Equal Payment Plan | 35.00 USD | 41.00 USD | 17.50 USD |
| 36-Month Equal Payment Plan | 38.00 USD | 41.00 USD | 19.00 USD |
| 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment Plan | 41.00 USD | 41.00 USD | 20.50 USD |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- *A plan on the 6-Month Deferred Interest Plan, billing for 2 whole calendar months, with no lateness charge counting against it.* The plan is inside the opening band of 6 whole months: 29.00 USD reduced by 50 percent is 14.50 USD.
- *The same plan after 8 whole months of billing, still with no lateness charge counting against it.* The opening band has passed, so the base charge is the term's first-lateness fee of 29.00 USD.
- *The same plan with one lateness charge counting against it inside the stretch.* The base charge is that term's repeat fee of 39.00 USD, whether the plan has been billing 2 months or 8.
- *A plan on the 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment Plan.* That term's first-lateness fee and repeat fee are both 41.00 USD, so the first and third rows reach the same figure; inside the opening band the base charge would be 20.50 USD.
